description: Get the current monthly LLM feature budget (the LLM cost cap covering the 3 axes: safety classifier + secondary PII audit + eval baseline runner). Response = { budgetUsd, spentUsd, remainingUsd, periodStart, defaultBudgetUsd, minBudgetUsd, maxBudgetUsd }. Readable on Free and Pro+ alike; used when an AI agent decides "have we hit 80% of budget?" / "should we raise it?". Default $5/month; auto-resets at month boundaries (per YYYY-MM).
name: get_llm_budget
